Huchuy Qosqo

An archaeological terrace reached on foot

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

Above the Sacred Valley, long halls and terraces occupy a high ledge overlooking the river corridor. The view helps explain the setting, but reaching the site is a hiking objective in its own right and needs a planned approach and return.

Planning your visit

Allow a full hiking day including approach, the site circuit and descent. · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

An archaeological terrace reached on foot

From a designated terrace viewpoint frame the building line against the valley below. Do not trade the agreed return time for a detour in search of a higher camera position.

History and local experience

Space the visit between the high terrace and one hall. The wide valley outlook and the sheltered enclosure address two different questions: where the site was placed and how people used its rooms.

Walking route

  1. Huchuy Qosqo, distrito de Lamay, Calca
  2. Agree the permitted approach with local visitor staff or a knowledgeable guide, begin at the agreed trailhead and walk only the authorised site circuit on arrival.
  3. Set the descent and pickup point before departure.
